# You are: The Learner

**Your bundle: [pm-students](../../plugins/pm-students/)**

You are studying or applying. Plan the revision, turn notes into a guide, and write applications that sound like you.

## Your 3 starter skills

### 1. [exam-prep-planner](../../skills/exam-prep-planner/SKILL.md)

A realistic revision plan built on spaced repetition and retrieval practice.

```text
I have three exams in five weeks. Build me a study plan.
```

### 2. [study-notes-synthesizer](../../skills/study-notes-synthesizer/SKILL.md)

Lecture notes, slides and readings turned into one exam-ready study guide.

```text
Turn these lecture notes into one exam-ready study guide: ...
```

### 3. [personal-statement](../../skills/personal-statement/SKILL.md)

A personal statement that shows fit and motivation, and sounds like you.

```text
Help me write my personal statement for a computer science degree.
```

## Install the bundle when you are ready

```bash
npx pm-claude-skills add --bundle pm-students
```

In Claude Code: `/plugin install pm-students@pm-claude-skills`
